第478章 皇家的子嗣（第1页）
与其他的房间不同的是，这个包间的墙壁厚度是其他包间墙壁的两倍，而包间的门有两道。
现在皇甫皓轩与蓝若晴、皇甫亦轩就坐在这个包间里面。
“二哥，你怎么还有这么一个好去处？”
“这是我们当初建酒楼的时候，玄曦的主意。他说万一以后有什么事情需要商议的时候，我们可以来这里。只是以前我们的事情都不是在酒楼生意忙的时候，所以随便在哪里都是可以说的。这一次的不同，外面的人光是声音就可以把整个酒楼掀起来，所以我们还是来这里比较好，安静。”
“好！那么你刚才想要问的是什么？”
“她没事！她只是想吓吓我而已，而我根本就没有被她吓倒。现在无论她耍什么小把戏，在我眼中，都不过是一道小菜，不值得我们费心费力的去猜测。”
“我知道你们一直以来都是想要保住那个孩子。可是对我来说，莹雪的孩子才是我的孩子。蓝汐冷生下的孩子，如果也同她一样恶毒狠辣，那我宁可亲手掐死他！”
“蓝汐冷之所以会这样，全都是因为她的外婆和她的母亲的缘故。如果她不是在这样的环境中长大，那么她就不会这么坏。”蓝若晴替蓝汐冷辩解着。
“或许是这样的，可是孩子生下来，由她带到大，还会是个偏激又固执的人。我是不会相信，她可以带出来一个善良可爱的孩子的。”皇甫亦轩似乎看到了蓝汐冷肚子里那个孩子的将来，直接就否定了他的性格和人生。
“这样对一个还未出世的孩子来说，真的是不公平的。”皇甫皓轩也觉得蓝若晴的说法有道理。
“那么该怎么做呢？难道就承认了他的存在吗？若不是你们极力的想要留下这个孩子，恐怕蓝汐冷都活不过今天！我有时真的后悔中秋那天所做的事情，不如就让她随便找个人，自生自灭好了！”
皇甫皓轩听了哈哈大笑道：“你是后悔被狐狸缠上身了吗？”
“我不后悔，我只怕那只狐狸会后悔，遇到了一个她从未见过的猎人。”
皇甫亦轩只是喝着茶水，没有回答。
即会保证孩子的周全，也会保持皇宫的安宁。
“无论如何，我希望你保证孩子的安全。我知道，上官莹雪已经有了喜讯，可是蓝汐冷所怀的，也算是皇家的第一个子嗣。历史以来都说，皇家的第一个子嗣是要留着的，这样子孙后代才会越来越兴旺，所以才希望保蓝汐冷肚子里的孩子。”皇甫皓轩怕皇甫亦轩做出伤害蓝汐冷的事情，在一旁提醒着他。

Chapter 478 The Royal Children (Page 1)
Different from other rooms, the walls of this private room are twice as thick as those of other private rooms, and the private room has two doors.
Now Huangfu Haoxuan, Lan Ruoqing, and Huangfu Yixuan are sitting in this private room.
"Second brother, why do you still have such a good place to go?"
"This was Xuan Xi's idea when we first built the restaurant. He said that if we need to discuss anything in the future, we can come here. But in the past, our affairs were not done when the restaurant was busy, so we could talk about it anywhere. The difference this time is that the sound of people outside can set off the entire restaurant, so it is better for us to come here to be quiet."
"Okay! So what did you want to ask just now?"
"She's fine! She just wanted to scare me, and I wasn't intimidated by her at all. No matter what little tricks she plays now, in my eyes, they are just a side dish, and they are not worth our efforts to guess."
"I know you have always wanted to keep that child. But to me, Yingxue's child is my child. If the child born by Lan Xileng is as vicious and cruel as her, then I would rather strangle him to death with my own hands!"
"The reason Lan Xi Leng is like this is all because of her grandmother and her mother. If she didn't grow up in such an environment, then she wouldn't be so bad." Lan Ruoqing defended Lan Xi Leng.
"Maybe that's the case, but after the child is born and brought up by her, he will still be an extreme and stubborn person. I don't believe that she can bring out a kind and lovely child." Huangfu Yixuan seemed to have seen the future of the child in Lan Xi Leng's belly, and directly denied his character and life.
"This is really unfair to an unborn child." Huangfu Haoxuan also felt that Lan Ruoqing's statement made sense.
"Then what should we do? Does that mean we admit his existence? If you hadn't tried so hard to keep this child, I'm afraid Lan Xileng wouldn't have survived today! Sometimes I really regret what I did on the Mid-Autumn Festival. It's better to just let her find someone to fend for herself!"
Huangfu Haoxuan laughed loudly after hearing this and said, "Do you regret being entangled by a fox?"
"I don't regret it, I'm just afraid that the fox will regret it, meeting a hunter she has never seen before."
Huangfu Yixuan just drank tea and did not answer.
It will not only ensure the safety of the children, but also maintain the tranquility of the palace.
"In any case, I hope you can ensure the safety of the child. I know that Shangguan Yingxue has received good news, but what Lan Xi Leng is carrying can be regarded as the first child of the royal family. Historically, it has been said that the first child of the royal family must be kept, so that future generations will become more and more prosperous, so I hope to protect the child in Lan Xi Leng's belly." Huangfu Haoxuan was afraid that Huangfu Yixuan would do something to hurt Lan Xi Leng, so he reminded him from the side.
